name: 4894-longdecode-7b-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one a3 node
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine, one node
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 1, 16 requests, safety cap 1800 s, warmup first 10% and cooldown last 10%, both sized in requests and applied on completion, leaving 12 scored.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix bucket, request format plain; prompt exactly 5 tokens and output exactly 2000 tokens with EOS ignored, so every request runs 2000 decode steps.
purpose: A long-form story generator on a 7B model, writing 2000-token pieces from brief prompts for 16 concurrent users across two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.4.2-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 2

# Declared rather than defaulted: this engine resolves the multi-GPU executor backend as
# "ray if ray is importable in the venv, else mp". The `ray` package must be installed.
distributed-executor-backend: ray

dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
